name: canonical_atomic_tool_bank
description: Reusable semantic atomic tools for GEM computer-use data generation. Stage2 should select from this bank instead of inventing task-specific high-level tools.

function.name: open_resource
function.description: Open an application, page, service, URL, or workspace so later tools can inspect or modify it.

resource_type.description: Kind of resource, such as app, website, page, service, folder, or workspace.

target.description: Name, URL, or identifier of the resource to open.

function.name: list_records
function.description: List records from a named collection, optionally narrowed by a simple query string.

collection.description: Collection to list, such as classes, emails, files, accounts, map_regions, or assignments.

query.description: Simple query, filter, or empty string when listing the whole collection.

function.name: search_records
function.description: Search a named collection for records matching a user-visible query.

query.description: Search query grounded in the user request or prior tool output.

function.name: get_record
function.description: Retrieve one record from a named collection by id.

record_id.description: Identifier of the record to retrieve.

function.name: read_state
function.description: Read a named state view or status summary exposed by the environment.

view.description: Name of the state view or status area to read.

target_id.description: Optional target identifier or empty string for a global view.

function.name: authenticate
function.description: Authenticate to a service or account using a provided credential.

service.description: Service or application to authenticate against.

credential_type.description: Credential type, such as password, picture_password, token, or sso.

credential_value.description: Credential value supplied by the user or prior state.

function.name: verify_session
function.description: Verify that an authentication session is active and usable.

function.name: locate_file
function.description: Find a file by name or path before upload, export, attachment, or sharing.

file_name.description: File name or path to locate.

function.name: create_upload_session
function.description: Create an upload session with a provider or destination.

function.name: upload_resource
function.description: Upload a located file or local resource through an existing upload session.

resource_id.description: File or local resource identifier to upload.

function.name: set_permission
function.description: Set sharing or access permission for a resource.

resource_id.description: Resource whose permission should be changed.

visibility.description: Requested visibility, such as private, shared, public_link, or organization.

function.name: verify_permission
function.description: Verify that a resource has the required sharing or access permission.

function.name: get_share_link
function.description: Get a shareable link for a resource whose permissions allow linking.

function.name: export_resource
function.description: Export a resource to a requested format and name.

format.description: Export format, such as csv, gpx, pdf, or txt.

export_name.description: Output name for the exported resource.

function.name: download_resource
function.description: Download a resource to a target destination.

destination.description: Destination folder, device, or storage area.

function.name: verify_resource
function.description: Verify that a resource exists and has the expected status.

expected_status.description: Expected status, such as uploaded, attached, downloaded, exported, or saved.

function.name: create_record
function.description: Create a record in a named collection.

collection.description: Collection where the record should be created.

function.name: update_record
function.description: Update fields on an existing record.

patch.description: Fields to merge into the record.

function.name: attach_resource
function.description: Attach a resource to another target record.

function.name: delete_record
function.description: Delete a record from a named collection.

function.name: send_message
function.description: Send or stage a message through a channel.

channel.description: Message channel, such as email, chat, notification, or scanner_email.

subject.description: Message subject or empty string if not applicable.

function.name: add_recipient
function.description: Add a recipient to an existing message, job, or sharing target.

function.name: verify_delivery
function.description: Verify that a message or shared resource was delivered or made available.

target_id.description: Message, job, or resource identifier to verify.

function.name: check_constraint
function.description: Check a task constraint such as storage, permission, availability, size, or policy before continuing.

required_value.description: Required value or threshold expressed as a string.

function.name: start_job
function.description: Start a long-running job such as scan, export, download, import, or conversion.

target_id.description: Target resource or record for the job.

function.name: poll_job
function.description: Poll a long-running job for its current status and outputs.

function.name: cancel_job
function.description: Cancel a running job when it should not continue.

function.name: verify_job_result
function.description: Verify that a completed job produced the expected result.

expected_status.description: Expected final status or output condition.
